scope: Read-only PERSONAL-003 Phase 9 evidence reconciliation; no interactions or tests rerun.

acceptance.requirement: Trigger the existing scheduler in a controlled due-time window.
acceptance.note: Native TaskStore due time; no owner prompt.

acceptance.requirement: Verify BullGod fetches current news without another manual prompt.
acceptance.note: Live unattended delivery after a preserved model-unavailable attempt; source ID/title/link match the captured live response.

acceptance.requirement: Verify relevant articles are deduplicated against prior coverage.
acceptance.note: Labeled overlap fixture; zero selected items, no message, no new attention.

acceptance.requirement: Persist the successful result.
acceptance.note: Delivered live run links source ID 200217 to message seq 2.

acceptance.requirement: Reopen the conversation.
acceptance.note: Same owner session.

acceptance.requirement: Ask “What needs my attention?”.
acceptance.note: Owner prompt at seq 3.

acceptance.requirement: Explain developments and pending decisions using actual state.
acceptance.note: Source-backed finding and pending track-story decision.

acceptance.requirement: Request a sourced social post draft.
acceptance.note: Owner request at seq 5.

acceptance.requirement: Prepare the post but do not publish it.
acceptance.note: Draft remains awaiting_publication_approval.

acceptance.requirement: Save publication as an approval-required decision.
acceptance.note: Durable pending decision with source provenance.

acceptance.requirement: Restart the isolated instance.
acceptance.note: Same commitment, decision and run IDs.

acceptance.requirement: Switch the underlying model.
acceptance.note: GPT-5.6 Luna is recorded in per-turn restart/answer usage; this claim is bound to those records. The lifecycle owner subsequently populated the top-level model summary from that evidence.

acceptance.requirement: Verify decisions, sources, commitments and grants survive restart/model change.
acceptance.note: Saved records were present after restart; later denial/revocation are distinct owner actions.

acceptance.requirement: Deny publication and verify no post occurs.
acceptance.note: The owner decision is denied. The publication request path only calls the native proposal recorder; that recorder stores execution_status=blocked because the connector is unsupported. The sandbox allows outbound only to the selected model gateway and fixed news relay. No packet capture was performed, so there is no wire-level claim.

acceptance.requirement: Run another scheduled check with overlapping articles.
acceptance.note: Controlled replay; no live-access claim.

acceptance.requirement: Verify no duplicate briefing or repeated decision.
acceptance.note: Unique occurrence key; no selected story, message, or new attention.

acceptance.requirement: Present a material update using a clearly labeled fixture.
acceptance.note: Fixture is labeled simulated, not verified news.

acceptance.requirement: Verify the update can create a new relevant notification.
acceptance.note: GPT-5.6 Luna produced a new finding and pending decision from fixture data.

acceptance.requirement: Revoke the standing read grant.
acceptance.note: Revision 2; read_authorized=false.

acceptance.requirement: Verify a later scheduled callback does not fetch.
acceptance.note: Fetch count and commitment run IDs unchanged; pointer disabled.

acceptance.requirement: Simulate a failed or timed-out model response.
acceptance.note: Controlled pre-provider timeout; native conversation run is failed.

acceptance.requirement: Verify no false success, duplicate delivery, or lost commitment.
acceptance.note: No new delivery; prior state remains; grant stays revoked.

acceptance.requirement: Resume and obtain a natural-language explanation of current state.
acceptance.note: GPT-5.6 Luna receipt text exactly matches assistant seq 16; covers four checks, live/fixture boundary, denial, revocation, timeout and next authorization.

supplemental_ui.note: Latest native recheck passed after the CSS source update; earlier failed attempt remains historical.

limits: The first unattended scheduler attempt failed because the model was unavailable; it is preserved before the successful live delivery.
Overlap and material-update behaviors use labeled fixtures, not a second live fetch.
The model-timeout case is injected before a provider call.
Hosted CI was not established by this audit.
No packet capture was made; the no-publication conclusion is supported by the denied persisted decision, blocked mutation path, and sandbox egress allow-list.
lifecycle_closeout_note: After independent reconciliation, the parent finalized the native receipt status and model summary; execution records and audited answer text were unchanged.
